title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.33252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). translated_title: MonoQPM：将特征分解为概念以实现内在可解释性与预测性能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33252v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：与叠加现象一样，多义性是实现可解释深度神经网络的主要障碍之一。虽然这些现象通常本质上是相互关联的，但二次规划增强模型（QPM）却自然地将二者解耦。QPM 通过用极少量特征的稀疏二值分配来表示类别，在设计上就避免了其最终特征的叠加，但仍然表现出多义性。然而，如何度量多义性仍是一个开放性问题。本工作提出了一种以实用性为核心的多义性度量方法，通过量化由干扰引起的激活误差的减少量，从而带来了使用共形预测（CP）获得更紧凑预测集的实际效用。我们明确地将 QPM 的多义特征解耦为单义概念，从而构建了单义 QPM（MonoQPM）。由于其特征已被解缠，MonoQPM 可以作为一个效率显著更高的共形预测器（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出 MonoQPM，通过将 QPM 模型的多义特征解耦为单义概念以实现内在可解释性，并基于干扰引起的激活误差提出实用的多义性度量方法，从而显著提升共形预测的效率并获得更紧凑的预测集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MonoQPM, which disentangles the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts for inherent interpretability, introduces a utility-focused measure of polysemanticity based on interference-induced activation errors, and enables significantly more efficient Conformal Prediction with tighter prediction sets.
